bonuses.name: Automata Mechanic
bonuses.text: Cybernetica Datasmiths automatically reduce the time by half for any Tech test. They add +1d on Tech tests made to fix or repair a damaged machine and +3d on Tech tests made to repair a damaged Battle-Automata.

abilities.name: Datasmith
abilities.text: As a free action, at the beginning of his turn, a Cybernetica Datasmith may make a DN 2 Tech test. If successful, he may change the battle protocols of any Kastelan Robots within 12m. He may individually select which protocol each robot changes to.
